text: Tecaverso Labs. Science in virtual reality.
In projectile motion, explore how an object moves through the air. Compare launch angles and follow its trajectory, velocity and the effects of gravity.
On the inclined plane, watch the box slide. See how weight, the normal force and friction affect its motion.
Explore the Solar System in the gravitation lab. Follow planetary orbits and discover facts about each planet in a model designed for learning.
In resistor circuits, investigate an electrical circuit. Flip the switch and observe the light bulb, the current and the instrument readings.
In thermodynamics, investigate how a gas changes. Explore pressure, volume and temperature in processes with constant temperature, constant volume or constant pressure.
In the waves lab, create pulses and follow them along a string. Explore periodic and standing waves, changing the frequency and amplitude.
